title: adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig — DebugAllocator leak: discarded AppendResult.record.metadata
scope: tests/integration/adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig (test-only leak, no production code path affected). Forwarded from ISS-0691/GH-753 scope expansion at Step 00.
description: tests/integration/adp06_pipeline_run_correlation_test.zig leaks one heap allocation per run. The discarded AppendResult captures the return value of store.append() with _ =, but the returned .record.metadata is heap-allocated by duplicateFromParams() (src/event_store/store.zig:1368). Same-shape leak as ISS-0691/GH-753 (different file, same root cause). Filed as a separate issue per core-directive one issue, one run.
disposition: Test-only allocation leak; no production code path affected. Fix: capture the AppendResult and free result.record.metadata.
